goal: Align 24H and All-Time PnL calculations by removing synthetic 24h market drift on new positions and eliminating residual dust in portfolio state

contracts.interfaces: export interface PortfolioPerformanceMetrics { pnl24hUsd: number; pnl24hPct: number; pnl7dUsd: number; pnl7dPct: number; allTimePnlUsd: number; allTimePnlPct: number; realizedProfit24h: number; realizedProfit7d: number; realizedProfitAllTime: number; totalFeesPaidUsd: number; grossRealizedProfitUsd: number; spotDelta24h: number; spotDelta7d: number; totalSpotUnrealizedPnl: number; }
function_signatures: calculateRealisticPortfolioPerformance(trades?: TradeRow[], holdings?: Record<string, CryptoHolding>, livePrices?: Record<string, number>, allCoinsStats?: Record<string, any>, virtualUsdt?: number): PortfolioPerformanceMetrics

execution_steps: Update portfolioMath.ts to bound 24h delta to real position entry price and UTC calendar boundary
Update PortfolioContext.tsx to clear localHoldings state on demo reset
acceptance_criteria: calculateRealisticPortfolioPerformance outputs pnl24hUsd 0.00 when holdings entry price equals current price and trades is empty
pnl24hUsd matches allTimePnlUsd for positions created at current market price
closed trades with negative pnl_usd subtract from realizedProfit24h and realizedProfitAllTime
resetDemoBalance clears localHoldings to empty object in state and storage
definition_of_done: Pnl across 24H and Todo tabs evaluates to identical 0.00 on newly initialized account
